boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Box Office is open on show days 3 hours prior to show time. Tickets are available for purchase on our website thedomevb.com
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: We accept all major credit cards.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available for pickup at the box office. Don't forget to bring a photo ID that matches the name on the ticket order! Unfortunately, guests aren't able to leave tickets at Will Call for others to pick up. If you're meeting up with friends, we recommend arranging a time and place to hand off tickets directly. If tickets or passes are being left for you - including Meet & Greet passes, backstage passes, press/media passes, or tickets from the tour or a promotional company - they'll only be available at the box office. These items usually arrive close to door time, so please plan to pick them up then and not earlier.

venues.parkingDetail: There is no onsite parking at the venue but plenty of public parking within blocks.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Yes, accessible seating locations can be found in section 100WC or 302WC for all shows. There is additional accessible seating for reserved floor shows.

generalInfo.generalRule: For general information for the venue visit thedomevb.com
generalInfo.childRule: Our venue is all ages, unless otherwise noted on a show. Children 2 and under do not require a ticket, but must sit on a caregiver's lap if they are located in the seats.
